label: Create/Update a category
description: Create a new ecommerce category or update an existing one, identified by the mandatory `id` field. When `updateEnabled` is set to `false` (the default), the endpoint performs an insert and returns `201`; if the category ID already exists, a `400` error is returned. When `updateEnabled` is `true`, the endpoint performs an upsert, returning `201` for a new category or `204` when an existing category is updated. The `name` field is mandatory for creation but optional for updates.

deletedAt.description: UTC date-time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ) of the category deleted from the shop's database

id.description: Unique Category ID as saved in the shop

isDeleted.description: category deleted from the shop's database

name.description: **Mandatory in case of creation**. Name of the Category, as displayed in the shop

updateEnabled.description: Facilitate to update the existing category in the same request (updateEnabled = true)

id.description: ID of the category when a new category is created

preconditions: eCommerce app activated (needed before any call in this area)

postcondition.assert: the entity exists and its fields equal the inputs that were sent

verification.notes: HTTP 403 to a call with inputs that cannot succeed: {"message": "Your eCommerce section is not yet activated.", "code": "permission_denied"}
